description: This file defines functionality to delete a favorite article for the current user, including a command, validator, and handler logic.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a favorite article identified by slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command ensuring the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of removing a favorite for the current user and returning the updated article data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to remove the article from favorites, throws exceptions if article or user not found, and returns the updated article envelope.
